sql:
WITH published AS (
  SELECT ka.id, ka.title, kc.name AS category_name, ka.view_count, ka.helpful_count, ka.not_helpful_count
  FROM knowledge_articles ka
  LEFT JOIN knowledge_categories kc ON kc.id = ka.knowledge_category_id
  WHERE ka.is_published = true AND ka.deleted_at IS NULL
),
agg AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_published_articles,
         SUM(helpful_count) AS total_helpful,
         SUM(helpful_count + not_helpful_count) AS total_votes
  FROM published
)
SELECT
  p.title,
  p.category_name AS knowledge_category_name,
  p.view_count,
  p.helpful_count,
  p.not_helpful_count,
  CASE WHEN (p.helpful_count + p.not_helpful_count) = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND(p.helpful_count::numeric / (p.helpful_count + p.not_helpful_count), 4)
  END AS helpful_rate,
  a.total_published_articles,
  ROUND(a.total_helpful::numeric / NULLIF(a.total_votes,0), 4) AS platform_avg_helpful_rate
FROM published p
CROSS JOIN agg a
ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 20
note: Report is platform-wide across all tenants (no tenant filter was specified, since the question is about KB effectiveness in general rather than a particular merchant); article titles are not guaranteed unique across tenants, so if the Support Ops Manager wants this scoped to a single merchant or needs tenant/merchant name shown, let me know and I'll re-run. helpful_rate and platform_avg_helpful_rate are rounded to 4 decimals; rows with zero feedback show helpful_rate as null as requested.
